decision.reason: [ev-2c2bce4c1f26] states the change clearly in prose: the WireGuard userspace-mode fallback, which it names as Helm `wireguard.userspaceFallback`, is deprecated and will be removed later, so WireGuard users will need a kernel with WireGuard support. However, the values validator checked the chart values files [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and [ev-39a22d88e2f5] and found no `wireguard.userspaceFallback` key in either release. That refutes the Helm path the prose names. More evidence is needed to settle which setting the fallback really is (for example, the chart template, the agent flag or the ConfigMap key that controls it) before the subject and the exposure condition can be written as typed values.
